errors_code_validation_failed_detail: Some of what you entered can’t be used. Fix the fields marked below and try again.
errors_code_unauthenticated_detail: Your session ended or you haven’t logged in yet. Log in and we’ll bring you back here.
errors_code_invalid_credentials_detail: That email, handle or password doesn’t match an account. Check them and try again.
errors_code_forbidden_detail: Your account doesn’t have permission for this action. If you think it should, contact a moderator.
errors_code_email_not_verified_detail: Open the link we emailed you to verify your address, then try again. You can request a new link in Settings.
errors_code_not_found_detail: We couldn’t find what you asked for. It may have been moved or deleted.
errors_code_gone_detail: This was removed and won’t come back.
errors_code_conflict_detail: This changed while you were working on it. Reload to see the latest version, then try again.
errors_code_payload_too_large_detail: That file is over the size limit. Compress it or upload a smaller one.
errors_code_unsupported_media_type_detai: We can’t accept this kind of file. Check the allowed formats and try again.
errors_code_rate_limited_detail: Wait a moment and try again.
errors_code_rate_limited_retry: Too many requests. Try again in {seconds, number} s.
errors_code_turnstile_required_detail: Complete the security check to confirm you’re not a bot, then try again.
errors_code_suspended_detail: Your account is suspended, so this action is blocked. Check your email for details or contact a moderator.
errors_code_reauth_required_detail: This action needs a recent login. Log in again and then repeat it.
errors_code_internal_detail: This is a problem on our side. We’re working on it. Try again in a few minutes.
errors_code_unavailable_detail: The site is under maintenance or overloaded. Try again in a few minutes.
errors_code_unknown_detail: The request failed for an unexpected reason. Try again; if it keeps happening, tell us the reference below.
errors_network_detail: We can’t reach SOTF Mods. Check your connection and try again.
errors_validation_summary: {count, plural, one {Fix # field to continue.} other {Fix # fields to continue.}}
errors_field_too_short: {min, plural, one {Use at least # character.} other {Use at least # characters.}}
errors_field_too_long: {max, plural, one {Use at most # character.} other {Use at most # characters.}}
errors_field_invalid_email: Enter a valid email address, like name@example.com.
errors_permission_detail: You need a different role to open this page. Go back or log in with another account.
